faq.q: Do you pick up from the airport?
faq.a: Yes — airport pickup and drop-off can be arranged for any trip, and is included in the multi-day packages.

faq.q: Can the itinerary be changed after booking?
faq.a: Yes, within reason. Most guests adjust the pace or swap a stop once they're actually here — that flexibility is the point of a private driver.
Vehicle, fuel, driver-guide, and park or site entry fees where noted on the tour. Accommodation and meals are quoted separately based on what you'd like.

faq.q: How many people can join one trip?
faq.a: Most vehicles comfortably seat up to 6–8 depending on the tour. Larger groups are possible — ask when you write in.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: A few weeks ahead is comfortable, especially in the December–March and July–August high seasons. Shorter notice often works too — just ask.

about.introBody1: Krish Lanka Tours & Travels is one driver-guide, not a call centre. When you book a trip, you're booking me — I plan the route, I drive, and I'm the one who shows up at your hotel at 5:30am when the light over the park is worth losing sleep for.
about.introBody2: I grew up around these roads and I still learn something new on most trips. Sri Lanka rewards slowness more than it rewards a packed checklist, and that's the trip I try to build for every guest.
about.valuesTitle: How I try to run things

values.title: Small groups only
values.body: One vehicle, one group. Your trip is never merged with strangers to fill seats.

values.title: Local, not scripted
values.body: I take you to the places I'd take my own visiting family, not just the stops every bus makes.

values.title: Honest about pace
values.body: If a route is too rushed for what you want, I'll say so before you book it, not after.

values.title: Responsible travel
values.body: The small guesthouses, family spice gardens, and local paddlers I work with are part of how the money stays in the community.

about.experienceBody: I've driven and guided across the island long enough to have a shortlist of quiet mountain temples the tour buses miss, and to know which park roads are empty at sunrise. That's the experience I bring to every itinerary.

faqPage.pageSubtitle: Everything guests usually ask before booking a private Sri Lanka tour.

more.q: How far in advance should I book?
more.a: For peak season (December–March) we recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks ahead. Last-minute requests are often still possible — just message us on WhatsApp.
Yes — private airport transfers from Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB) to anywhere on the south coast or beyond. See our Airport Transfer page for details.

more.q: Can I combine several tours into a multi-day trip?
more.a: Absolutely — that's exactly what our Custom Trip Planner is for. Pick your destinations, dates, vehicle and hotel style, and we'll build the route.

airportTransfer.title: Colombo Airport to Your Hotel — Direct & Comfortable
airportTransfer.subtitle: Skip the taxi queues. A driver with your name on a sign, a clean air-conditioned car, and a straight road to your first night in Sri Lanka.
airportTransfer.intro: Landing after a long flight is not the moment to negotiate a taxi fare. We track your flight, meet you at Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB) arrivals with a name board, and drive you directly to your hotel in Ahungalla, Bentota, Galle or anywhere on the south coast — no stops, no detours, no surprises on price.
points: Flight tracking — we adjust for delays automatically
Meet & greet at CMB arrivals with a name board
Fixed price agreed before you travel — no surprises
airportTransfer.ctaBody: Send us your flight number and hotel, and we'll confirm your transfer within the hour.

surfing.title: Surfing in Hikkaduwa & Weligama
surfing.subtitle: Sri Lanka's best beginner and intermediate breaks, with a driver who knows exactly when the waves are working.
surfing.intro: Hikkaduwa and Weligama are two of Sri Lanka's most reliable surf spots — gentle, forgiving breaks that are ideal for beginners, with enough swell on the right day to keep intermediate surfers happy. We arrange private transport to whichever spot is working best, board hire on request, and can point you to the right local surf schools if you want a lesson.
points: Private transport to Hikkaduwa or Weligama
Local knowledge of which spot is working that day
Great for beginners — gentle, sandy-bottom breaks
Combine with a beach day or turtle hatchery visit nearby
surfing.ctaBody: Tell us your experience level and we'll plan the right day for you.

taxiService.title: Private Taxi Service Across Sri Lanka
taxiService.subtitle: Point-to-point transfers between cities, beaches and hill country — comfortable, fixed-price, and on your schedule.
taxiService.intro: Not every trip needs a full guided tour — sometimes you just need a reliable, comfortable ride from A to B. Our taxi service covers point-to-point transfers anywhere in Sri Lanka, in clean air-conditioned vehicles with experienced drivers, at a fixed price agreed before you travel.
points: Point-to-point transfers, any city to any city
Fixed price agreed in advance — no meter surprises
Air-conditioned cars, vans and SUVs available
Available for one-way or return journeys
taxiService.ctaBody: Tell us your route and dates, and we'll send a fixed quote.
